subject: PrismCare: Success ownership, kickoff sequencing & clear next owners
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
To: Natalie Perez <natalie@prismcare.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PrismCare: Success ownership, kickoff sequencing & clear next owners

Hi Natalie —

Thanks again for the signature — welcome aboard. I wanted to outline a concise plan so PrismCare has a predictable first 30 days and clear points of contact from our side. High level:

- Confirmed start: Monday, Oct 26 (technical kickoff + admin tasks)
- Success owner: Ben Carter (primary)
- Implementation lead (customer-facing): Karthik Iyer (technical runbook)
- Quick asks for you: final list of PrismCare EMR users who need integration access; preferred MRR billing contact for procurement; any data residency constraints beyond standard US region.

Attached: SOW (v3), Mutual Action Plan (starter), kickoff agenda (draft).

Proposed next steps:
1) Ben to schedule 60-min kickoff for Oct 26 (we'll reserve 11:00–12:00 PT)
2) Karthik to run pre-kickoff tech-check (10/21 or 10/22) to validate sandbox access and sample payloads
3) Procurement and legal to confirm the redline status — I see DocuSign shows the SOW as signed but procurement@prismcare.com please confirm if you need a PO.

Ben & Karthik, please confirm owner availability and whether you want the kickoff split into ops + tech blocks or keep both in one session.

Natalie, if the dates above don't work we'll adjust.

Best,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: RDW-PrismCare-SOW-v3.pdf (pdf), MutualActionPlan_PrismCare_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), kickoff-agenda.pdf (pdf)
From: Natalie Perez <natalie@prismcare.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.j@prismcare.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@prismcare.com
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PrismCare: Success ownership, kickoff sequencing & clear next owners

Thanks Grace — this looks good. Confirming a few items:

- Oct 26 11:00–12:00 PT works for our team (Alex and I will attend).
- We'll send over the EMR user list by Friday (10/16).
- Procurement: we do prefer a PO; procurement@prismcare.com can advise on timing.

Two asks from our side before the kickoff:
1) Can Karthik share the sandbox endpoint and a short checklist of required test data fields so our devs can prepare?
2) On the SOW: Alex flagged the billing cadence footnote — can you confirm when Redwood will begin metering production tokens?

Appreciate the clear owner mapping. Looking forward to the kickoff.

—Natalie
Natalie Perez
Director, Product Operations | PrismCare Health
+natalie@prismcare.com

Subject: Re: PrismCare: Success ownership, kickoff sequencing & clear next owners

Grace / Karthik — I'm good to be primary success owner. Confirming the plan and a couple internal notes for the handover:

- I'll own the kickoff invite and the SOW acceptance checklist (internal ops run)
- Karthik: please share a short tech-check checklist by EOD 10/16 with sandbox URL + required sample payload keys. I'll forward to Natalie.
- Risk items to call out in the kickoff: SSO timing (PrismCare uses Okta), sample payload mismatch with their EMR (we should pre-validate fields), and PO timing from procurement (may delay full provisioning).

Suggested kickoff structure (60 mins):
- 0–15 min: Introductions & SOW/acceptance summary (Ben)
- 15–40 min: Technical scope and sandbox checklist (Karthik)
- 40–55 min: Integration milestones & responsibilities (Ben + Natalie)
- 55–60 min: Immediate action items and calendar invites

I will draft the invite and share calendar times for Oct 26 11:00 PT. Will also attach a short risk register and owner contact card in the invite.

Ben
Ben Carter
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com
